cases.desc: SCOPE BP: what is blood pressure, what do the two numbers mean
cases.answer:
Blood pressure measures how hard your blood pushes against your artery walls when your heart beats and rests. The top number (systolic) shows the pressure when your heart beats, while the bottom number (diastolic) is the pressure when it's at rest.

To help manage your blood pressure, focus on reducing sodium in your diet by choosing fresh ingredients over processed foods.

cases.desc: SCOPE BP: why check my blood pressure at home
cases.answer:
Checking your blood pressure at home regularly helps you keep track of any changes and ensures that your hypertension is being managed effectively. It's important to catch any fluctuations early so adjustments can be made as needed by your care team.

Try setting a routine, like checking it once daily at the same time, to monitor trends over time.

How do you feel about incorporating home blood pressure monitoring into your daily routine?

cases.desc: SCOPE BP: interpret my own systolic reading
cases.answer:
Your doctor will interpret whether your blood pressure reading is controlled based on your personal health targets. It's important to monitor and track these readings regularly. Try reducing your sodium intake further by avoiding processed foods and high-sodium condiments.

cases.desc: SCOPE BP BM: apa itu tekanan darah tinggi
cases.answer:
Tekanan darah tinggi, atau hipertensi, bermaksud tekanan darah anda terlalu tinggi ketika jantung memompa darah ke seluruh badan. Angka tekanan darah terdiri daripada dua nombor: angka atas (sistolik) dan angka bawah (diastolik). Jika angka-angka ini sentiasa tinggi, ia boleh menyebabkan masalah jantung dan stroke.

Untuk mengekalkan tekanan darah yang sihat, cuba kurangkan pemakanan yang tinggi natrium dan minyak terhidrat, serta tambah aktiviti fizikal anda setiap hari.
